items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I got my first set from a guy names Jess Priserssen... he had a drum shop downtown here and he took a liking to me.

ctx.x: What was — can you recall what it was like to get your first drumset? Was it a big event?

Oh yeah. I got my first set from a guy names Jess Priserssen, I think he was from Sweden. Anyway he had a drum shop downtown here and he took a liking to me. That’s my luck. People just took a liking to me and helped me a lot. I got a lot of help from other people and that’s why I was never prejudiced because a lot of white guys helped me too. You know I was never raised, I hate this guy and that guy and that guy because I got help from so many, people of all races, you know, really helped me. I take people for…
Yeah well it seems to be a mutual —
